scope: Root read all fixed WEB verses in 2CH9-12 from tool output. Context hazards only, not map or profile approval.
hazards: 9:10 Huram servants belong to royal trading context; do not attach artisan Huram-abi.
9:16,20 House of Forest of Lebanon is palace building, not geographic Lebanon region.
9:21 ships of Tarshish transport language does not establish modern port identification.
9:26 River without explicit proper name needs contextual limitation; country borders are not point coordinates.
9:27 lowland is general landscape; do not silently assert specific Shephelah region identity.
9:29 Nathan prophet differs from David son; Ahijah/Iddo textual historical-source citations do not prove modern article identities.
10:4,6-14 Solomon is unnamed father and elders former king context; speakers and quoted proposals must be distinguished.
10:16 David and Jesse are historical ancestry/house context, not living participants.
10:17 Israel children in Judah distinguish population from northern political kingdom.
10:18 Hadoram fixed spelling should not silently substitute Adoram without variant evidence.
11:1 Judah and Benjamin denote houses/population, not city centers or direct ancestor actions.
11:18 Mahalath has paternal Jerimoth and maternal Abihail; Eliab is Abihail father, Jesse her grandfather.
11:20-22 WEB Maacah granddaughter of Absalom; do not turn granddaughter into daughter, nor merge same-name Maacahs by spelling.
11:22 Abijah son of Maacah intended successor; actual succession not until12:16.
12:3 Lubim/Sukkiim/Ethiopians are groups; do not turn group into place or adopt obsolete racial generalizations.
12:5-8 Shemaiah speaking divine quotation to Rehoboam/princes; track speaker/addressees.
12:13 Naamah Ammonitess mother of Rehoboam, distinct from male genealogical names or geographic Naamah.
12:15 Shemaiah prophet and Iddo seer are cited source authors; do not infer modern publication identity.
